qualification: ITI (NCVT/SCVT) / Graduate / B.Sc. / Diploma / B.Tech depending on post
salary: Pay Scale Details:Supervisor posts carryLevel S-1 pay matrix ₹27,600–95,910; Engraver and Jr. Office/Bullion Assistant/Lab Assistant posts carryLevel B-3 ₹21,540–77,160orLevel B-4 ₹23,910–85,570; and Junior Technician posts carryLevel W-1 ₹18,780–67,390.
